citations.title: Security & Compliance
excerpts: ## Compliance certifications
SnapLogic upholds the highest security and compliance standards so that our customers do not have to compromise data integration with security and governance.

![AICPA SOC1 Type 2](https://www.snaplogic.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/AICPA-SOC1-Type-2.svg) ![AICPA SOC 2 Type 2](https://www.snaplogic.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/AICPA-SOC2.svg) ![AICPA SOC3](https://www.snaplogic.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/AICPA-SOC3.svg) ![HIPAA Compliant](https://www.snaplogic.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/HIPAA.svg)
![GDPR Compliant](https://www.snaplogic.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/GDPR.svg) ![SSAE 23](https://www.snaplogic.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/SSAE-23.svg)

The SnapLogic Platform for Agentic Integration is certified by third parties with SOC 1 Type 2 (ISAE 3402 / SSAE 22), SOC 2 Type 2, SOC 3, and HIPAA-HITECH. Additionally, the platform is compliant with CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act), GDPR (EU: General Data Privacy Regulation), and general privacy standards.

The SnapLogic Platform runs on Amazon Web Services (AWS) cloud infrastructure, one of the most powerful and flexible cloud computing environments. We leverage the security and compliance capabilities of AWS, including ISO 9001, ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, SEC Rule 17-a-4(f), DIACAP, FISMA, ITAR, CIS, CJIS, CSA, MPAA, MTCS Tier 3, G-Cloud, and DoD CSM Levels 1-2 and 3-5.

basis.reasoning: The company security page explicitly lists SOC 2 Type 2, HIPAA-HITECH, and GDPR compliance. ISO standards in the same passage are described as AWS capabilities, not SnapLogic certifications, so they are excluded.

citations.title: SnapLogic - Applied AI Architect
excerpts: * **Lead Executive Engagements:** Command the room during discovery and scoping with VP and C-level stakeholders, translating technical capabilities into sharp business impact for CIO/CTO audiences.

* **Deploy into Complex Environments:** Own the end-to-end technical rollout into customer VPCs, on-prem Docker hosts, and firewalled networks. Resolve the critical blockers (SSO, enterprise OAuth, egress policies) that typically derail pilots.

* **Build the Context Layer:** Move beyond surface-level demos by engineering data connectivity (via Model Context Protocol / MCP) and context layers, ensuring the AI agent is genuinely usable, reliable, and trustworthy.
* **Drive Footprint Expansion:** Identify adjacent business functions and high-value use cases, turning initial team beachheads into account expansion and undeniable ROI.
* **Shape the GTM Narrative:** Represent SnapLogic’s agentic AI point of view in briefings and competitive situations, codifying field wins into repeatable playbooks for the GTM team.

* **Feed the Product Loop:** Partner directly with our core engineering team building on the Claude Agent SDK—bringing field realities, edge cases, and customer needs straight back into the product roadmap.
